name: RHODEX NatCat Loss — latest report (economic & industry loss)

response_schema.description: PostgREST always returns an array. natcat_latest has exactly one row (or none if the natcat table is empty): the most recent year on file, with each metric taken from the latest period in that year that has a figure (FY -> Q3 -> Q2 -> Q1).

economic_loss_b.description: Economic loss, $B, cumulative year-to-date as of economic_period

industry_loss_b.description: Insured (industry) loss, $B, cumulative year-to-date as of industry_period

latest_metadata.description: Free-form report detail from the newest row, e.g. regional_distribution

data_source_description: RHODEX's own NatCat loss table in Supabase (public.natcat), read through the natcat_latest view. Same Gallagher Re-sourced dataset as v1/v2, migrated off Bubble 2026-11-18. The total-then-latest-quarter fallback that v2 did with value_path chains now happens in the view, so each metric is a single path.
